meta_description: Auto Locks Leicester provides emergency locksmith services across Leicester. Fast response, 24/7 callouts, locked out? Call us now for swift solutions.
hero_subhead: We arrive fast when you're locked out, whether it's midnight or morning. No waiting, no stress.
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to lock repairs and installations, we handle every locksmith problem quickly and fairly.

services.title: Emergency Lockout Service
services.desc: Locked out of your home, office, or car? We'll get you back inside in under 30 minutes, any time of day or night. No damage to your lock.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Faulty locks, broken keys, or worn mechanisms? We repair or replace locks on doors, windows, and vehicles with minimal disruption.

services.title: Residential Lock Installation
services.desc: Upgrade your home security with new locks, deadbolts, or multi-lock systems. We fit quality locks that last and keep your family safe.

services.title: Commercial Lock Solutions
services.desc: Businesses need reliable access control. We install, upgrade, and maintain locks for offices, shops, and industrial premises across Leicester.

services.title: Car & Van Lockouts
services.desc: Locked your keys in the car? We open vehicle locks without damage and can supply spare keys on site.

services.title: Lock Rekeying Service
services.desc: Change the key to match a different lock without replacing the whole mechanism. Perfect after house moves or lost keys.

about_pullquote: I started this because I got locked out myself and nobody answered the phone.
about_para_1: Auto Locks Leicester has been helping people get back in for over 15 years. What started as a one-person operation answering emergency calls has grown into a trusted locksmith service across the city. We're still owner-run because that's the only way to guarantee the same fast, honest response every time.
about_para_2: Customers come back to us because we show up when we say we will, fix things right the first time, and never overcharge. We're not interested in taking shortcuts or replacing locks that just need adjusting. That reputation—built on speed and fairness—is what keeps our phone ringing.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out on a Sunday evening and Auto Locks had me back in within 20 minutes. The lad was friendly, professional, and didn't try to sell me anything I didn't need. Will definitely call them again.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had a broken lock on my front door after a break-in attempt. They came out same day, replaced it with a proper deadbolt, and the price was fair. Can't ask for more than that really.
reviews.author: Lisa R.

reviews.text: Called at 2am when I realised my keys were stuck in the van. They actually answered, came out in about 25 minutes, and sorted it without any fuss. Brilliant service at any hour.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

opening_hours_sub: Emergency calls answered immediately — day, night, or weekend
